# CHOIVE

> CHOIVE checks how clearly public information explains and supports a business. It also records answers from Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini through their provider APIs.

Website: https://choive.com/
Method: https://choive.com/methodology
Report: https://choive.com/report
Contact: hello@choive.com

## What CHOIVE does

CHOIVE is an AI visibility and business evidence diagnostic.

It checks four areas:

- Clarity: Can people understand what the business does and who it serves?
- Trust: Do reliable public sources support the business's claims?
- Difference: Is there a specific, supported reason to choose the business?
- Ease: Can people and automated systems find, read, and verify the information?

CHOIVE combines these four areas into a score out of 100.

The score measures public evidence. It does not control what an AI provider says.

## AI provider measurements

CHOIVE sends buyer questions to the official APIs provided by Anthropic, OpenAI, Perplexity, and Google.

Each provider answers separately. A completed answer may mention the business, mention another business, mention several businesses, or name no business.

These are recorded API measurements. They are not transcripts from the public Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, or Gemini apps. Public apps may return different answers.

A failed provider request stays marked as failed. CHOIVE does not treat a failed request as proof that the business was absent.

## The free diagnostic

The free diagnostic checks:

- the business's website and public information;
- recorded answers from available AI providers;
- the four CHOIVE pillars;
- a verified head-to-head competitor when enough evidence exists; and
- the main evidence gaps found during the run.

No account is required.

## The full analysis

The paid analysis explains:

- the evidence behind every awarded score point;
- which provider questions completed;
- which completed answers mentioned the business;
- which companies were named in the recorded answers;
- the verified head-to-head and wider market competitors;
- what the business can change first; and
- how to confirm that each change is complete.

The analysis may include ready-to-use website assets. Every asset must use facts recorded during the diagnostic. A business or developer must check those facts before publishing.

## The CHOIVE Report

The CHOIVE Report is a branded PDF based on the saved diagnostic evidence.

It is designed for owners, teams, agencies, and decision-makers who need a shareable record of the findings and actions.

## How the score works

### Clarity — 25 points

Measures whether the business, offer, audience, and market are explained clearly.

### Trust — 25 points

Measures confirmed reviews, independent coverage, credentials, named customers, documented outcomes, and other relevant public proof.

Missing or unavailable evidence does not automatically mean the evidence does not exist. It means CHOIVE did not confirm it during that run.

### Difference — 25 points

Measures whether public evidence supports a meaningful reason to choose the business over alternatives.

### Ease — 25 points

Measures whether the website supplies clear page information, useful structured data, accessible content, and consistent business details.

## Competitor definitions

Head-to-head competitor: A separately researched business offering a close substitute to the same type of customer in the same serviceable market.

Market competitor: A business competing for the same customers, attention, or budget without being an exact replacement.

AI-named alternative: A company named in a completed provider API answer. It does not automatically become the verified head-to-head or market competitor.

## Evidence rules

CHOIVE separates confirmed evidence, model interpretation, and unavailable evidence.

Every awarded point should have a rule, evidence record, source, verification type, and confidence level.

CHOIVE does not promise future rankings, revenue, recommendations, or a future score.

CHOIVE does not claim that one website change will cause an AI provider to recommend a business.

## Website assets

An analysis may include:

- an llms.txt draft;
- homepage headline options;
- a meta description;
- JSON-LD structured data; and
- a customer evidence template.

An llms.txt file is a voluntary reference file. CHOIVE does not claim that every AI system reads or uses it.

Google-Extended controls whether website content may be used to improve certain Gemini models. Blocking Google-Extended does not prove that a website is excluded from Gemini answers or Google Search.

## Who CHOIVE is for

CHOIVE can diagnose a business, product, service, creator, personal brand, or organization.

It supports local, regional, national, international, and global markets.

## One sentence

CHOIVE records AI provider answers, checks the public evidence behind a business, and shows what can be improved and verified.
